review.assessment: The change introduces src/lib.rs with a stubbed is_valid_ipv4 function that unconditionally returns false, alongside a unit test expecting "192.168.0.1" to evaluate to true. Because the actual validation logic is completely missing, the acceptance suite fails immediately upon running the test. The submitted code does not fulfill the task requirement to parse and verify dotted-quad IPv4 addresses.

findings.actual: Function returns false, triggering assertion failure and exit code 101
findings.call: Run test suite (cargo test --lib) or directly invoke is_valid_ipv4("192.168.0.1")
findings.defect: Stubbed implementation rejects canonical IPv4 addresses
